All 38 others (R-T2..R-T8 on production IL, both-direction list checks, made-up offender and twin cases) pass.

Reuse and list shape: file calls ModuleRules (DomainReachesOnlyTheKernelAndTheBaseLibrary, DomainIsReachedFromOutsideOnlyBy, ApplicationIsReachedFromOutsideOnlyBy, AdaptersAreReachedFromOutsideOnlyByTheCompositionRoot, OutboundEdges) with its own ModuleWording, as WorkItems/Forecasting boundaries files do; no rule body copied. Every list is an inline string[] of full type names (edges as "Source -> Target"), compared both ways by the shared verdicts; every list entry is deleted one at a time (must be named "Not on the list, and offending") and a made-up entry is added (must be named "On the list, but no longer offending"). D-14: the five Application->Adapters edges are listed by exact source type (AuthenticationMethodSchema x2, WorkTrackingSystemFactory x2, WorkTrackingConnectorFactory x1) and a test pins the source set to exactly those three; no namespace/layer exemption. D-7: one R-T7 entry, JiraWorkTrackingConnector -> IDeliveryForecastBlockRenderer, pinned to exactly that by a second literal.

Positions and twins: Domain rule (offender ADomainRuleAskingTheLicence, twin ATranslationRule); Domain inbound (newcomer vs listed caller); Application inbound (newcomer incl. async-only reach vs listed caller, API-namespace, WorkItems-namespace and composition root with a nested type as twins); Adapters inbound (newcomer vs composition root and listed caller); Application outbound (7 offender cases: DbSet, data context, API DTO, unlisted connector, other module adapter, unlisted repository, key ring; twin = listed connector construction passes); other contexts (9 cases, each with a listed-renderer twin that must not be named); repositories (connector offender vs listed service twin). Not vacuous. Legal sets are not looser than design: composition root is exactly Program (+nested), R-T4 legal = API ns + WorkItems module ns as designed, R-T3/R-T5 list exact types; R-T6 forbidden set (EF, Data, API, any module Adapters, own Adapters, stored records, key ring, demo data) is stricter than the Work Items/Forecasting siblings; R-T7 covers more than the retired rule. R-T8 derived from R-T6 by StoredRecordsPattern: the rule itself still scans the whole module, so a connector->repository edge is not in the derived list and fails; a connector-sourced entry added to R-T6 fails there as stale and fails the source-set test; sound.

Measured differences from the design guess (feature-delta record "C1 lists as measured from the IL"): R-T3 WorkItemService only (Program absent); R-T4 plus DemoDataFactory (reads IWorkTrackingSystemFactory), no ConnectionSaveService/Encryption readers; R-T5 only the two connection controllers; R-T6 ConnectionSecrets, ConnectionHealthVerdictRepository, RepositoryBase, IRepository (health), UnreadableSecretException, IRepository (OAuth).
